create_timelimit_wrapper: create a TimeLimit wrapper around a CompilerEnv to cap episodes at a fixed number of steps
reset_timelimit_env: reset a TimeLimit-wrapped environment to zero elapsed steps before starting a new episode
multistep_with_timelimit: run multiple actions through a TimeLimit wrapper that auto-truncates when the step limit is reached
fork_timelimit_env: fork a TimeLimit-wrapped environment preserving the current elapsed step count and max step limit
review_timelimit_truncation: review the TimeLimit wrapper to understand how it sets TimeLimit.truncated in the info dict on truncation
